scope: First runtime evaluation of the existing reserved authored corpus. Original static labels/results remain unchanged. This public split is not blinded.

dev-03.reason: Selected Python is excluded; no executable instruction is documented.

dev-04.reason: Only environment state is documented; there is no executable process or established configuration requiredness.

dev-06.reason: Alternative/placeholder installation instructions require manual selection; none is silently chosen.

hold-02.reason: Documented cp is outside the executor subset; no replacement is silently inserted.

hold-03.reason: Contradictory Python declarations and multiline installation require review; the prior static label mapping error is retained separately.

hold-04.coverage_limit: This single command cannot establish the exact resource-failure cause from its logs or a controlled interruption phase; those components are abstentions. Development signal/resource tests are reported separately.

limitations: The original eight-development/four-held-out fixture definitions are unchanged and public, not blinded.
Unsupported workflows remain explicit abstentions rather than silently repaired instructions.
Rule metrics count per-fixture category-presence assertions on executed cases, not universal causal accuracy.
Log signatures remain suggestions; no remote-package availability or exact signal/root cause is inferred.
Runtime results must be frozen and retained even if they reveal failures; do not tune on their outcomes.
